Upendra Kumar Singh

📧 upendrasingh111988@gmail.com| 📞 +91-9579422363

🔗 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/upendra-kumar-singh-750747347

💻 GitHub: https://github.com/upendrasingh111988

Professional Summary

Senior Backend Developer with over 10.10  years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot,Spring Batch, Microservices, Kafka, and AWS. Strong experience in distributed architecture, system design, CI/CD, Jules, Spinekker, DevOps, and container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker. Have lead experience of around 3 to 4 years, mentoring teams and driving delivery of key projects in agile environments.

Technical Skills

Languages: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Microservices, Kafka, Angular
Databases: Oracle, SQL, MySQL, Postgres, mangoDb
Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, SAGA Pattern, CQRS, SOLID, OOPS, API Design
Cloud/DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, SNS, Beanstalk, RDS), EKS, Jenkins, Jules, Spinnaker, Docker, Kubernetes
Tools: Liquibase, Splunk, Kibana, Git,BitBucket, Maven,Gradle,Groovy, IntelliJ,eclipse, VS Code

Professional Experience

GFT Technologies — Senior/Lead Java Engineer

March 2025 – Present

Developed a UI Dashboard backend and frontend for displaying job run summaries per environment.
• Integrated with adapters and implemented APIs to accept and persist job run data in PostgreSQL.
• Used Spring Boot, React, Liquibase, deployed using Spinnaker and Jules on AWS EKS.
• Led a team of developers and reviewed code and architecture.



IBM India Pvt LTD — Senior Application Developer

Dec 2022 – March 2025

Developed APIs for generating, validating, redeeming, and unredeeming coupons.
• Implemented business logic using Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Kafka, and GCP Pub/Sub.
• Supported production issues and performance tuning of coupon workflows.

UST Global — Senior Software Engineer

Sept 2021 – Nov 2022

Designed and developed tag service APIs in Spring Boot and Angular.
• Worked on tagging customer data with luggage tags and supported search and retrieval APIs.
• Deployed using AWS EC2, S3, Kubernetes and Docker.

Larsen & Toubro Infotech — Senior Software Engineer

July 2019 – Sep 2021

Developed API for Card Installment services.
• Supported account number-based loan inquiry and updates.
• Used Spring Boot, REST API, Oracle DB, Docker.

Key People Solutions Pvt Ltd — Software Engineer

Nov 2018 – May 2019

Worked on a British Telecom XML-based integration project.
• Built XML request/response handling and validations.
• Used Java, JSP, MySQL, Struts, WebLogic.

Core Softech Solutions & Technology Pvt Ltd — Software Engineer

Dec 2014 – Oct 2018

Built a KL scoring tool to analyze employee skills on applications.
• Designed backend modules and provided application support.

Education

Sushila Devi Bansal College of Technology (RGPV University), Indore — B.E. (2010)
